01 研究問題與正式結果範圍

本研究比較六種迴歸方法在小樣本縱向資料中的還原能力。兩份模擬使用已知的資料生成機制，分別檢查因子排序、影響函數、預測，以及成對變數的方向證據。每個問題使用各自的評分目標；本文按任務呈現全部情境與模型結果。

1.1 兩份模擬回答的問題

研究一（Core）：在 14 個候選因子中，模型能否找回真正進入結果生成式的因子？找回因子後，能否還原線性、平滑非線性、斜率轉折與效果修飾？模型對新個體，以及已有追蹤歷史的個體，能提供多少預測能力？

研究二（Direction）：給定調整變數後，A 與 B 是否仍提供彼此的增額預測資訊？共同的證據規則何時畫出 A→BA\to BA→B 或 B→AB\to AB→A，何時保留方向未定？在已知生成方向的評分條件下，各迴歸方法能否還原影響曲線與效果修飾？

一個 replicate 是一次重新生成、重新擬合、重新評分的完整模擬。六模型在同一次 replicate 共用資料與評分條件，因此比較可以配對。表中的次數只包含正式結果；開發、校準與補充診斷另外說明。

本模擬研究為作者與國立臺灣大學醫院合作專題的一部分，但並未使用任何患者資訊。模擬所用資料皆為合成資料；本頁呈現合成資料的生成設定、評估方法與彙總結果。

02 比較方法與共同實作原則

2.1 六種迴歸方法

  • Mean：以訓練目標的平均值作常數預測。
  • LMM：以線性固定效果與個體隨機截距描述結果；已有追蹤歷史時使用估計的個體效果。
  • GAM：使用加法 spline 基底與 ridge 懲罰估計影響函數。
  • RF：以多棵迴歸樹的平均值作預測。
  • GPR：以核函數描述輸入之間的相似程度，估計函數與預測值。
  • MERF：交替估計森林固定部分與個體隨機截距；已有追蹤歷史時使用估計的個體效果。

2.2 相同資訊與個體分組

六模型共用每次生成的資料、分組切分與參考資料。ID 用於分組、隨機效果與評分，不當作一般數值特徵。中位數補值、缺失指示欄、輸入尺度與目標尺度等轉換都只在對應的訓練資料上估計，再套用於保留資料。模型擬合不接收真因子名單、真曲線或真箭頭。

各模型共用相同資料與可用資訊；模型自由度、計算成本，以及研究一的樹數依表 2 設定。RF 與 MERF 的比較涵蓋整套模型規格，而非單獨改變隨機截距的對照實驗。

3.3 影響函數、替身、缺失與污染

三種基礎函數

hlinear(x)=x,hsmooth(x)=0.8sin⁡(πx/2)+0.2(x2−1),hhinge(x)=max⁡(0,x−0.25).\begin{aligned}h_{\mathrm{linear}}(x)&=x,\\[0.9em]h_{\mathrm{smooth}}(x)&=0.8\sin(\pi x/2)+0.2(x^2-1),\\[0.9em]h_{\mathrm{hinge}}(x)&=\max(0,x-0.25).\end{aligned}hlinear​(x)hsmooth​(x)hhinge​(x)​=x,=0.8sin(πx/2)+0.2(x2−1),=max(0,x−0.25).​

函數的中心化與標準化

h~q(x)=hq(x)−E[hq(G)]SD⁡[hq(G)],G∼N(0,1),q∈{linear,smooth,hinge}.\begin{aligned}\widetilde h_q(x)&=\frac{h_q(x)-\mathbb{E}[h_q(G)]}{\operatorname{SD}[h_q(G)]},\\[0.9em]G&\sim\mathcal{N}(0,1),\qquad q\in\{\mathrm{linear},\mathrm{smooth},\mathrm{hinge}\}.\end{aligned}hq​(x)G​=SD[hq​(G)]hq​(x)−E[hq​(G)]​,∼N(0,1),q∈{linear,smooth,hinge}.​

3.4 全部主情境與樣本量敏感度

下列 10 個主情境與 5 個敏感度設定均已完成正式模擬。每個條件塊列出生成設定、研究目的與結果說明；各設定的全模型數值見第 4 節。

S0 無額外生物標記訊號R=200R = 200R=200

研究目的
檢查在沒有真生物標記因子的條件下，模型是否仍產生虛假的重要性或曲線。
模擬條件
訓練資料為 50 個合成個體，每人 4 次訪視，共 200 個預定觀測；月份為 3、6、9、12。候選生物標記共 14 個，另有 8 個共同背景變數。真生物標記數為 0，所有生物標記的直接效應係數均為 0；共同背景效應仍保留。隨機截距與殘差部分的 ICC 參數為 0.25，殘差標準差為 0.70。未設定與真因子高度相關的誘餌變數。未加入生物標記缺失、訪視退出或額外離群污染。所有觀測結果依共同生成程序截斷至 [0,8][0,8][0,8]。
解讀重點
S0 的預測目標包含共同背景效應，評估項目為預測誤差與無直接效應生物標記的重要性。真因子集合為空，完整集合還原率與真因子曲線誤差列為不適用。

S1 單一線性效應R=200R = 200R=200

研究目的
建立函數形式最簡單的有訊號對照，檢查因子辨識與線性曲線還原。
模擬條件
訓練資料為 50 個合成個體，每人 4 次訪視，共 200 個預定觀測；月份為 3、6、9、12。候選生物標記共 14 個，另有 8 個共同背景變數。唯一真因子為 X1X_1X1​，直接效應為 0.60hlinear(X1)=0.60X10.60 h_{\mathrm{linear}}(X_1)=0.60X_10.60hlinear​(X1​)=0.60X1​。隨機截距與殘差部分的 ICC 參數為 0.25，殘差標準差為 0.70。未設定與真因子高度相關的誘餌變數。未加入生物標記缺失、訪視退出或額外離群污染。所有觀測結果依共同生成程序截斷至 [0,8][0,8][0,8]。
解讀重點
與 S2、S3 比較時，樣本量、噪音參數及結構係數保持相同，以評估模型對線性、平滑與門檻函數的還原能力。各情境的訊號變異由相應函數與實際 X 分布共同決定。

S2 單一平滑非線性效應R=200R = 200R=200

研究目的
檢查模型是否能辨識真因子並還原彎曲的平均反應，同時作為樣本量敏感度的共同基準。
模擬條件
訓練資料為 50 個合成個體，每人 4 次訪視，共 200 個預定觀測；月份為 3、6、9、12。候選生物標記共 14 個，另有 8 個共同背景變數。唯一真因子為 X1X_1X1​，直接效應為 0.60h~smooth(X1)0.60\widetilde h_{\mathrm{smooth}}(X_1)0.60hsmooth​(X1​)。h~smooth\widetilde h_{\mathrm{smooth}}hsmooth​ 由 0.80sin⁡(πx/2)+0.20(x2−1)0.80\sin(\pi x/2)+0.20(x^2-1)0.80sin(πx/2)+0.20(x2−1) 在標準常態下中心化並標準化而得。隨機截距與殘差部分的 ICC 參數為 0.25，殘差標準差為 0.70。未設定與真因子高度相關的誘餌變數。未加入生物標記缺失、訪視退出或額外離群污染。所有觀測結果依共同生成程序截斷至 [0,8][0,8][0,8]。
解讀重點
此情境以完整集合還原率評估因子辨識，以 ALE 誤差評估平滑曲線還原，並分別計算新個體與已知個體的預測誤差。

S3 單一門檻型效應R=200R = 200R=200

研究目的
評估模型對局部斜率改變的還原能力。
模擬條件
訓練資料為 50 個合成個體，每人 4 次訪視，共 200 個預定觀測；月份為 3、6、9、12。候選生物標記共 14 個，另有 8 個共同背景變數。唯一真因子為 X1X_1X1​，直接效應為 0.60h~hinge(X1)0.60\widetilde h_{\mathrm{hinge}}(X_1)0.60hhinge​(X1​)。原始形狀為 max⁡(0,x−0.25)\max(0,x-0.25)max(0,x−0.25)，再依標準常態分布中心化並標準化。隨機截距與殘差部分的 ICC 參數為 0.25，殘差標準差為 0.70。未設定與真因子高度相關的誘餌變數。未加入生物標記缺失、訪視退出或額外離群污染。所有觀測結果依共同生成程序截斷至 [0,8][0,8][0,8]。

生成器事先將折點設定為 0.25，評估重點為折點兩側的曲線形狀與斜率變化。

S6 較強個體異質性R=200R = 200R=200

研究目的
以 S2 為基準，檢查較大的個體隨機截距如何影響因子、曲線及兩種預測任務。
模擬條件
訓練資料為 50 個合成個體，每人 4 次訪視，共 200 個預定觀測；月份為 3、6、9、12。候選生物標記共 14 個，另有 8 個共同背景變數。唯一真因子為 X1X_1X1​，直接效應維持 0.60h~smooth(X1)0.60\widetilde h_{\mathrm{smooth}}(X_1)0.60hsmooth​(X1​)。隨機截距與殘差部分的 ICC 參數為 0.55，殘差標準差為 0.70。未設定與真因子高度相關的誘餌變數。未加入生物標記缺失、訪視退出或額外離群污染。所有觀測結果依共同生成程序截斷至 [0,8][0,8][0,8]。
解讀重點
ICC 從 0.25 改為 0.55，殘差標準差仍為 0.70，因而提高隨機截距變異。新個體預測使用群體資訊，已知個體預測則可結合前期訪視估計的個體截距。

F2 弱訊號與高度相關誘餌R=275R = 275R=275

研究目的

模擬條件
訓練資料為 50 個合成個體，每人 4 次訪視，共 200 個預定觀測；月份為 3、6、9、12。候選生物標記共 14 個，另有 8 個共同背景變數。唯一真因子為 X1X_1X1​，直接效應為 0.30h~smooth(X1)0.30\widetilde h_{\mathrm{smooth}}(X_1)0.30hsmooth​(X1​)。隨機截距與殘差部分的 ICC 參數為 0.25，殘差標準差為 0.70。X13X_{13}X13​、X14X_{14}X14​ 為無直接效應的誘餌，在缺失與退出之前，樣本中與 X1X_1X1​ 的相關係數分別精確設定為 0.90、0.95。未加入生物標記缺失、訪視退出或額外離群污染。所有觀測結果依共同生成程序截斷至 [0,8][0,8][0,8]。
解讀重點
X13X_{13}X13​、X14X_{14}X14​ 的直接結構效應為零，與 X1X_1X1​ 的高度相關性使其帶有代理預測資訊。此情境評估相關特徵間的重要性分配，以及真因子和誘餌在排名中的位置。

模擬條件
訓練資料為 50 個合成個體，每人 4 次訪視，共 200 個預定觀測；月份為 3、6、9、12。候選生物標記共 14 個，另有 8 個共同背景變數。真因子為 X1X_1X1​、X2X_2X2​，直接效應為 0.35h~smooth(X1)+0.175h~smooth(X2)0.35\widetilde h_{\mathrm{smooth}}(X_1)+0.175\widetilde h_{\mathrm{smooth}}(X_2)0.35hsmooth​(X1​)+0.175hsmooth​(X2​)；第二係數為第一係數的 0.50 倍。隨機截距與殘差部分的 ICC 參數為 0.25，殘差標準差為 0.70。無直接效應的 X13X_{13}X13​、X14X_{14}X14​ 與 X1X_1X1​ 的缺失前樣本相關係數分別為 0.80、0.85。14 個生物標記各儲存格的 MAR 缺失機率為 clip⁡(0.20[0.55+0.70DM+0.451{second-half visit}],0.01,0.65)\operatorname{clip}(0.20[0.55+0.70\mathrm{DM}+0.45\mathbf{1}_{\{\text{second-half visit}\}}],0.01,0.65)clip(0.20[0.55+0.70DM+0.451{second-half visit}​],0.01,0.65)，隨 DM 與訪視時點變化。固定抽取 10 個個體（20%），刪除其第 3、4 次訪視，留下 180 列；不加入額外離群值。所有觀測結果依共同生成程序截斷至 [0,8][0,8][0,8]。
解讀重點
此情境同時設定較弱的雙因子訊號、相關誘餌、MAR 缺失與訪視退出，以完整集合還原率、曲線誤差及預測誤差評估這組聯合條件下的表現。

3.5 每次模擬的完整流程

  1. 生成共同訓練與獨立考卷。按情境生成訓練資料，另生成 2,000 個新 ID 的測試資料；兩者都套用指定缺失、流失與污染。
  2. 在訓練資料內選擇設定。GAM、RF、GPR、MERF 以 3-fold GroupKFold 分組驗證，比較 ID 等權 MSE；最小者勝出，再於全訓練資料擬合。Mean／LMM 只有一個候選設定，沒有候選搜尋。
  3. 新個體預測。以共同測試資料評分；LMM／MERF 對新 ID 使用零個體效果。主要 latent 目標為 μ\muμ；觀測結果的 RMSE、MAE、R2R^2R2 另保存。
  4. 因子與函數還原。從獨立測試資料的完整 latent 資料取前 250 ID。以同一考卷對因子作 ID 軌跡區塊 permutation，每因子 3 次；以 20 個分位數區間計算模型與真函數 ALE。
  5. 已追蹤個體任務。另外從原訓練資料保留每個合資格 ID 的最後一筆觀測，僅用更早歷史重新調參與擬合。評分時提供最後一筆的當次 X，LMM／MERF 可使用該 ID 的估計效果；目標為 μ+b\mu+bμ+b。
  6. 保存與彙總。保存指標、警告與完成狀態；跨 replicate 計算平均與 MCSE。同一次 replicate 的模型差值配對彙總。

3.6 指標的數學定義

以第 rrr 次 replicate 的真因子集合 KrK_rKr​、模型重要性前 kkk 名集合 TrT_rTr​ 定義全中指標 Er=1{Tr=Kr}E_r=\mathbf{1}\{T_r=K_r\}Er​=1{Tr​=Kr​}，k=∣Kr∣k=|K_r|k=∣Kr​∣。Exact recovery 為 1R∑r=1REr\frac{1}{R}\sum_{r=1}^{R}E_rR1​∑r=1R​Er​。重要性是 permutation 前後對 μ\muμ 的 MSE 增量，除以乾淨合成結果變異。AP 綜合真因子在整份排名中的位置；family recovery 容許指定同族替身代表訊號來源。S0 的 k=0k=0k=0，Mean 亦無因子排序，故相關指標未定義。

標準化 ALE 誤差

ALEerrorr,kCore=1J∑j=1J(A^r,k,j−Ar,k,j)2sY,r.\mathrm{ALEerror}^{\mathrm{Core}}_{r,k}=\frac{\sqrt{\frac{1}{J}\sum_{j=1}^{J}(\widehat A_{r,k,j}-A_{r,k,j})^2}}{s_{Y,r}}.ALEerrorr,kCore​=sY,r​J1​∑j=1J​(Ar,k,j​−Ar,k,j​)2​​.

新個體的 latent RMSE

LatentRMSErnew=1n∑i,t(y^it−μit)2.\mathrm{LatentRMSE}^{\mathrm{new}}_r=\sqrt{\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i,t}(\widehat y_{it}-\mu_{it})^2}.LatentRMSErnew​=n1​i,t∑​(y​it​−μit​)2​.

A^\widehat AA、A 分別為模型與真函數的中心化 ALE；先以區間人數加權中心化，再對有效格點等權計算誤差，sY,rs_{Y,r}sY,r​ 是完整乾淨參考結果的 SD。雙真因子先在同一 replicate 內平均兩因子誤差，再作跨 replicate 彙總。已追蹤任務把 latent 目標換成 μ+b\mu+bμ+b。主表的 latent RMSE 以保留的評分列計算；觀測誤差的 ID 等權版本另存在下載表。

S4 以第一因子第 5–95 百分位的 15 點，與 DM∈{0,1}\mathrm{DM}\in\{0,1\}DM∈{0,1} 形成 30 個組合；對各組合在共同參考資料上平均預測，整個表面中心化後與真表面比較，再除以 sY,rs_{Y,r}sY,r​。此指標評估包含主效應的完整聯合反應面。

05 研究二：成對方向與影響方式的設計

5.1 合成來源、目標與共同原因

每次生成 50 個 ID、月份 3、6、9、12。用 SSS 表示當次生成方向的來源、TTT 表示目標；顯示名稱 A／B 依 replicate 輪替。控制集合 C=(MonthScaled,Age,Sex,DM,HTN,CKD,Z)C=(\mathrm{MonthScaled},\mathrm{Age},\mathrm{Sex},\mathrm{DM},\mathrm{HTN},\mathrm{CKD},Z)C=(MonthScaled,Age,Sex,DM,HTN,CKD,Z)。

來源變數

5.2 全部正式情境

D0 調整後無直接關係R=200R = 200R=200

研究目的
測量沒有額外 A–B 直接關係時，共同證據流程誤畫箭頭的比例。
模擬條件
每次生成 50 個合成個體，每人於第 3、6、9、12 月觀測，共 200 個預定觀測。共同調整集合 C 包含時間、Age、Sex、DM、HTN、CKD 與 Z；未設定 Core 式的候選生物標記或誘餌。直接效應函數 f(S,Z)=0f(S,Z)=0f(S,Z)=0。A、B 仍有共同調整變數造成的背景變化，但沒有額外共同原因。創新項的 ICC 參數為 0.25；來源的總創新標準差為 1，目標為 0.70，兩者的個體內相關結構使用相同 ICC。個體層與訪視層的創新項均為 Gaussian。未加入 A/B 缺失、訪視退出或離群污染。結果使用中性合成單位，沒有 [0,8][0,8][0,8] 截斷。
解讀重點
D0 的生成圖沒有 A–B 直接邊。結果按 no_edge、unresolved、false_arrow 與 invalid 四種決策狀態彙總，並以 false_arrow 比例衡量錯誤定向。

D1 線性 Gaussian 的方向不可辨識對照R=200R = 200R=200

研究目的
檢查當既有假設不足以唯一決定方向時，流程是否保留不確定性。
模擬條件
每次生成 50 個合成個體，每人於第 3、6、9、12 月觀測，共 200 個預定觀測。共同調整集合 C 包含時間、Age、Sex、DM、HTN、CKD 與 Z；未設定 Core 式的候選生物標記或誘餌。直接效應為 f(S,Z)=±0.60Sf(S,Z)=\pm0.60Sf(S,Z)=±0.60S。來源與目標噪音使用匹配的縱向相關結構；生成器標記此情境的方向為不可辨識。創新項的 ICC 參數為 0.25；來源的總創新標準差為 1，目標為 0.70，兩者的個體內相關結構使用相同 ICC。個體層與訪視層的創新項均為 Gaussian。未加入 A/B 缺失、訪視退出或離群污染。結果使用中性合成單位，沒有 [0,8][0,8][0,8] 截斷。
解讀重點
A、B 具有增額預測關係；方向評估將 D1 歸入不可辨識對照，出箭頭的決策計入 false_arrow。結果彙總出箭頭、保留未定與未偵測到增額關係的比例。

D2 線性非 Gaussian 創新項R=225R = 225R=225

研究目的
比較 D1，檢查改變噪音分布後，殘差不對稱證據是否能支援方向判斷。
模擬條件
每次生成 50 個合成個體，每人於第 3、6、9、12 月觀測，共 200 個預定觀測。共同調整集合 C 包含時間、Age、Sex、DM、HTN、CKD 與 Z；未設定 Core 式的候選生物標記或誘餌。直接效應仍為 f(S,Z)=±0.60Sf(S,Z)=\pm0.60Sf(S,Z)=±0.60S。創新項的 ICC 參數為 0.25；來源的總創新標準差為 1，目標為 0.70，兩者的個體內相關結構使用相同 ICC。來源、目標與 Z 的個體層及訪視層創新項皆改為 Laplace⁡(0,1)/2\operatorname{Laplace}(0,1)/\sqrt{2}Laplace(0,1)/2​，使各基礎創新項的變異為 1。未加入 A/B 缺失、訪視退出或離群污染。結果使用中性合成單位，沒有 [0,8][0,8][0,8] 截斷。
解讀重點
D1 與 D2 的設計差異為創新項分布。D2 以正確箭頭、錯誤箭頭、保留未定、未偵測關係與 invalid 的比例，評估此 Laplace 創新設定下的方向判斷。

模擬條件
每次生成 50 個合成個體，每人於第 3、6、9、12 月觀測，共 200 個預定觀測。共同調整集合 C 包含時間、Age、Sex、DM、HTN、CKD 與 Z；未設定 Core 式的候選生物標記或誘餌。直接效應與 D3 相同：f(S,Z)=±0.60tanh⁡(S)/0.628f(S,Z)=\pm0.60\tanh(S)/0.628f(S,Z)=±0.60tanh(S)/0.628。創新項的 ICC 參數為 0.25；來源的總創新標準差為 1，目標為 0.70，兩者的個體內相關結構使用相同 ICC。個體層與訪視層的創新項均為 Gaussian。每個個體獨立以 0.20 機率失去後兩次訪視，退出個體數由 Bernoulli 抽樣決定；A、B 各欄獨立以 clip⁡(0.20[0.55+0.70DM+0.451{second-half visit}],0,0.90)\operatorname{clip}(0.20[0.55+0.70\mathrm{DM}+0.45\mathbf{1}_{\{\text{second-half visit}\}}],0,0.90)clip(0.20[0.55+0.70DM+0.451{second-half visit}​],0,0.90) 產生 MAR 缺失。每個預定觀測獨立以 0.05 機率在目標加入隨機正負 3 的污染；污染先於退出與缺失。結果使用中性合成單位，沒有 [0,8][0,8][0,8] 截斷。

方向流程使用 A、B 皆觀測到的完整配對列。此情境同時加入訪視退出、兩欄 MAR 缺失與目標污染，以完整方向決策分布和曲線誤差評估聯合資料品質條件。

此情境的局部效果修飾診斷包含平均 ALE、Z=−0.50Z=-0.50Z=−0.50 與 Z=0.75Z=0.75Z=0.75 的中心化曲線差，以及完整條件反應面誤差，分別評估平均效應、交互作用對比和條件函數還原。

D9 的每個 ID 獨立以 0.20 機率移除後半訪視；A／B 各以 clip⁡(0.20[0.55+0.70DM+0.45late],0,0.90)\operatorname{clip}(0.20[0.55+0.70\mathrm{DM}+0.45\mathrm{late}],0,0.90)clip(0.20[0.55+0.70DM+0.45late],0,0.90) 機率缺失；每個原排程目標以 0.05 機率加 ±3\pm3±3。實現平均約保留 179.9 列，單格缺失 19.0%，任一 A／B 缺失 33.8%。這些條件與 Core 固定人數流失、正向污染不同。

5.3 三折 cross-fitting 與方向證據

  1. 建立共同完整 A/B 資料列。方向流程對缺失 A／B 使用 complete-pair 分析；不補造缺失的目標。六模型與兩方向使用相同資料列。
  2. 依 ID 分成三折。每折用其餘 ID 擬合 A∼CA\sim CA∼C、B∼CB\sim CB∼C、A∼C+BA\sim C+BA∼C+B、B∼C+AB\sim C+AB∼C+A 四個迴歸；所有轉換僅在訓練折估計。保留 ID 的 LMM／MERF 預測不使用該 ID 的估計隨機效果。
  3. 合併 out-of-fold 預測。同一 ID 內 viv_ivi​ 列的每列權重為 wit=1NIDviw_{it}=\frac{1}{N_{\mathrm{ID}}v_i}wit​=NID​vi​1​，使每個 ID 總權重相同。
  4. 計算增額改善與殘差相依。相對 RMSE 改善衡量候選來源是否提供額外資訊；兩方向的殘差 kernel alignment 形成方向 margin。
  5. 套用事前凍結門檻。輸出未偵測增額關係、方向未定、A→BA\to BA→B、B→AB\to AB→A 或 invalid；保留連續 gain 與 margin。
  6. 獨立評分形狀。以已知生成方向與另生成的 200 個乾淨參考 ID 計算曲線誤差；真方向只用於評分，不進入方向決策。

單向增額預測改善

gA→B=RMSEB∼C−RMSEB∼C+ARMSEB∼C.g_{A\to B}=\frac{\mathrm{RMSE}_{B\sim C}-\mathrm{RMSE}_{B\sim C+A}}{\mathrm{RMSE}_{B\sim C}}.gA→B​=RMSEB∼C​RMSEB∼C​−RMSEB∼C+A​​.

兩方向的平均改善

gˉ=gA→B+gB→A2.\bar g=\frac{g_{A\to B}+g_{B\to A}}{2}.gˉ​=2gA→B​+gB→A​​.

方向 margin

m=HB→A−HA→BHB→A+HA→B.m=\frac{H_{B\to A}-H_{A\to B}}{H_{B\to A}+H_{A\to B}}.m=HB→A​+HA→B​HB→A​−HA→B​​.

每個 RMSE 使用上述 ID 等權重。HA→BH_{A\to B}HA→B​ 是 A−A^baseA-\widehat A_{\mathrm{base}}A−Abase​ 與 B−B^fullB-\widehat B_{\mathrm{full}}B−Bfull​ 的 normalized kernel alignment；反向亦同。以兩殘差的距離建立 Gaussian 核、用權重中心化後：

H=∑i,jwiwjK~ijL~ij(∑i,jwiwjK~ij 2)(∑i,jwiwjL~ij 2)H=\frac{\sum_{i,j}w_iw_j\widetilde K_{ij}\widetilde L_{ij}}{\sqrt{\left(\sum_{i,j}w_iw_j\widetilde K_{ij}^{\,2}\right)\left(\sum_{i,j}w_iw_j\widetilde L_{ij}^{\,2}\right)}}H=(∑i,j​wi​wj​Kij2​)(∑i,j​wi​wj​Lij2​)​∑i,j​wi​wj​Kij​Lij​​

若 gˉ≤g0\bar g\le g_0gˉ​≤g0​，輸出 no_edge；有增額資訊但 margin 不足或只允許棄權，輸出 unresolved。m>m0m>m_0m>m0​ 且 gA→B>0g_{A\to B}>0gA→B​>0 才畫 A→BA\to BA→B；m<−m0m<-m_0m<−m0​ 且反向 gB→A>0g_{B\to A}>0gB→A​>0 才畫 B→AB\to AB→A。樣本不足或數值失敗另記 invalid。

5.4 校準、matched null 與規則凍結

先完成 11 情境×30=330 次校準，另作 D11（高個體差異 null）與 D12（D9 品質困難的 null）共 60 次，並以 D6／D11 各 10 次補足少見條件，共使用 410 次校準資料凍結規則。D11／D12 是校準補充；正式驗證仍為 D0–D10，2,350 次。

觀測條件依序分組：完整配對缺失比例>0.15>0.15>0.15 或完整訪視中位數<3<3<3 為缺失／稀疏組；其餘若個體平均值變異／總變異>0.65>0.65>0.65 為高個體間變異組；其餘一般組。比值取 A／B 較大者。最終凍結流程對一般組用 D0／D1／D7、高變異組用 D11、稀疏組用 D12，要求各組校準的假箭頭或 invalid 比例≤0.05\le0.05≤0.05，再最大化可定向情境的分組平衡正確率。D8 保留為未量測混雜壓力測試，未列入最終硬性安全門檻。

gain 網格為 {0,0.01,0.025,0.05,0.10}\{0,0.01,0.025,0.05,0.10\}{0,0.01,0.025,0.05,0.10}，margin 網格為 {0.05,0.10,0.20,0.30,0.50,0.75}\{0.05,0.10,0.20,0.30,0.50,0.75\}{0.05,0.10,0.20,0.30,0.50,0.75}。每個組別／模型須至少有 20 個安全對照與 20 個可定向校準案例。最終個別模型 (g0,m0)(g_0,m_0)(g0​,m0​)：LMM (0.05,0.50)、GAM (0.01,0.20)、RF (0.01,0.30)、GPR (0.01,0.50)、MERF (0.01,0.30)；Mean 僅棄權。另凍結按可觀測組別選擇方向／曲線引擎的 policy。驗證資料與校準資料 seed 不重疊，門檻未依最終驗證結果回調。

5.5 影響曲線、轉折與效果修飾的評分

將已知真方向的三個完整迴歸模型預測取平均，於來源訓練第 5–95 百分位的 41 點估計中心化 PD。每點使用固定均勻抽取、最多 64 列乾淨參考資料。ALE 使用 12 個分位數區間；參考資料列決定各區間質量 qjq_jqj​，局部差累積至區間中點，再作質量加權中心化。

區間質量加權 ALE 誤差

ALEerrorrDirection=∑jqj(A^r,j−Ar,j)2sT,r.\mathrm{ALEerror}^{\mathrm{Direction}}_r=\frac{\sqrt{\sum_j q_j(\widehat A_{r,j}-A_{r,j})^2}}{s_{T,r}}.ALEerrorrDirection​=sT,r​∑j​qj​(Ar,j​−Ar,j​)2​​.

高低修飾量的條件曲線差

D(x)=P(x,Z=0.75)−P(x,Z=−0.50).D(x)=P(x,Z=0.75)-P(x,Z=-0.50).D(x)=P(x,Z=0.75)−P(x,Z=−0.50).

sT,rs_{T,r}sT,r​ 是乾淨參考目標的 SD。Core 採格點等權，Direction 採區間質量加權；兩者的參考資料與標準化分母依各研究設定。D10 每條 P 先在來源格點中心化，再計算高低 Z 差，以消去 Z 的加法主效應；另沿訓練 Z 的第 5–95 百分位評整個條件反應面。

D4 的候選轉折以連續 hinge 最小平方法在內部格點搜尋，兩側至少各保留三點；相對線性擬合改善至少 10% 才記錄 knot。表格分別報告找到率與找到時的位置誤差。D10 另對來源 Q0.25→Q0.75Q_{0.25}\to Q_{0.75}Q0.25​→Q0.75​ 效果隨 Z 的曲線搜尋修飾轉折。這些是合成座標上的形狀診斷。

本研究的曲線分數是在真方向已知的條件下評分，目的在分開方向能力與函數能力。正式 bootstrap 次數為 0，沒有驗證曲線信賴帶、涵蓋率或整人重抽支持率。

LMM／GAM 在本比較中使用加法結構，其純交互作用對比誤差與 Mean 同為約 0.221。交互作用項與 tensor spline 的擴充規格列入後續比較。

07 Monte Carlo 不確定性、診斷與限制

7.1 平均值、MCSE 與配對差

平均值與 Monte Carlo 標準誤

θˉ=1R∑r=1Rθr,MCSE⁡(θˉ)=SD⁡(θ1,…,θR)R.\begin{aligned}\bar\theta&=\frac{1}{R}\sum_{r=1}^{R}\theta_r,\\[0.9em]\operatorname{MCSE}(\bar\theta)&=\frac{\operatorname{SD}(\theta_1,\ldots,\theta_R)}{\sqrt R}.\end{aligned}θˉMCSE(θˉ)​=R1​r=1∑R​θr​,=R​SD(θ1​,…,θR​)​.​

模型配對差與 Monte Carlo 區間

dr=θA,r−θB,r,CI0.95MC(dˉ)≈dˉ±1.96SD⁡(d)R.\begin{aligned}d_r&=\theta_{A,r}-\theta_{B,r},\\[0.9em]\mathrm{CI}^{\mathrm{MC}}_{0.95}(\bar d)&\approx\bar d\pm1.96\frac{\operatorname{SD}(d)}{\sqrt R}.\end{aligned}dr​CI0.95MC​(dˉ)​=θA,r​−θB,r​,≈dˉ±1.96R​SD(d)​.​

replicate 是彙總的統計單位，同次模擬的兩模型以差值配對。雙因子曲線先在 replicate 內平均，再計算跨次平均與 MCSE。Core 表格呈現平均與 MCSE；Direction 率指標使用 Wilson 區間，連續指標使用近似 MC 區間。

每設定至少 200 次，需要時每批追加 25 次，上限 500。主要率指標的停止條件為 MCSE⁡≤0.03\operatorname{MCSE}\le0.03MCSE≤0.03，主要標準化連續指標為 MCSE⁡≤0.02\operatorname{MCSE}\le0.02MCSE≤0.02。Direction 對 0／1 邊界比例採 Jeffreys 平滑；Core 使用樣本 MCSE，全對或全錯時為 0。Core 的 484 項與 Direction 的 138 項預設主要精度檢查全部通過。

率差 ±0.05\pm0.05±0.05 定義描述性實務接近範圍；連續誤差的 5% 規則在 Core 以逐次 (A−B)/B(A-B)/B(A−B)/B 彙總，Direction 以 0.05×max(兩平均誤差) 定界。本文的 MC 區間採探索性分析設定，未校正多重比較與分批停止。

7.2 開發、校準與 seed 重疊

Core 先以 450 次 pilot 進行開發，再以小型校準調整 F1／F2／F3 的難度；正式結果使用凍結的 benchmark_v2 設定。正式 3,350 次中，390 次（11.6%）重用開發期的 train／test／evaluation seed 組合；開發結果另行彙總。

既有事後排除 seed 重疊的敏感度分析保留 2,960 次，直接從完成結果篩選，未重新擬合。各情境／模型 exact recovery 的最大平均變化約為 1.53 個百分點，ALE 約為 0.0100，latent RMSE 約為 0.0084。Direction 校準與驗證的 data seed 重疊數為 0；D11／D12 目前只納入校準。

7.3 輸出有效與數值估計品質

零最終失敗表示流程產生有限的評分結果。Core 的 GPR kernel 邊界命中率在新／已追蹤任務約 99.7%／98.7%，LMM fallback 約 82.5%／69.2%，MERF 達 25 次上限約 7.9%／9.9%。Direction 每模型有 28,200 個折內 fits；GPR 邊界約 87.0%，LMM fallback 約 81.6%，MERF 44.4% 觸及上限，平均迭代約 17.96。

模型診斷另保存 kernel 邊界、LMM fallback、MERF 迭代次數與停止狀態。MERF 的 GLL 相對變化門檻為 0.001，最大迭代次數為 25；達到上限的擬合仍保留其有限評分結果。

7.4 評估範圍與後續工作

  1. 因子選取。Core 使用已知真因子數 k、latent μ\muμ 與完整參考因子評分。null 選取門檻、FDR 與自動選 k 尚待建立。
  2. 相關與共同原因。Core 採 ID-block permutation；Direction 包含已量測與未量測共同原因情境，以量化增額預測與方向規則在這些條件下的表現。
  3. 曲線不確定性。正式 Direction bootstrap=0\mathrm{bootstrap}=0bootstrap=0。後續工作包括信賴帶涵蓋率、整個體重抽，以及轉折搜尋的網格敏感度。
  4. 縱向預測。本研究評估提供當次 X 的條件預測；未來因子建模、個體內與個體間效果分解列為後續工作。
  5. 完整網路。兩份研究目前分別評估單一結果的還原與一對 A/B 的方向證據。完整網路還原、跨模型投票與自動選模將另行比較。

方法參考

Peters et al.（2014）：連續加法噪音模型的因果辨識條件；Mooij et al.（2016）：因果方向 benchmark；Apley & Zhu（2020）：ALE 與預測變數效果的視覺化。本研究採 ID 加權、縱向 cross-fitting 與合成情境校準實作上述評估流程。

II.1 第二部分｜八模型的因子篩選、方向校準與預測比較

本部分以八個模型進行比較，研究三項問題：未知真因子數時的訊號辨識能力、方向規則出箭頭時的正確率，以及模型規格與數值求解對預測和函數重建的影響。

比較模型為 Mean、LMM、GAM、RF、GPR、MERF、GAMM 與 BART。因子篩選與方向校準涵蓋八模型；同資料配對的性能實驗涵蓋 GPR、LMM、MERF、GAMM 與 BART 五模型。每項實驗依其預先指定的情境、任務與分母彙整。

方向可靠度六個控制情境各 300 次，另有 2,100 次可定向情境混合；D0–D10 各 200 次驗證。八模型的風險校準規則，以及既定方向規則的獨立驗證。

Ij=∑f=13nfn(15∑p=15Dfjp)I_j=\sum_{f=1}^{3}\frac{n_f}{n}\left(\frac{1}{5}\sum_{p=1}^{5}D_{fjp}\right)Ij​=f=1∑3​nnf​​(51​p=1∑5​Dfjp​)

此處的模型訓練、選參與重要性分數使用觀測結果 YYY。各模型的篩選規格為：Mean 常數基準；LMM 線性固定效果與隨機截距；GAM 的 knots 3／5、ridge 1／10；RF 300 棵樹、leaf 5／10、特徵比例 0.5；GPR 採 Matérn 3/2、零額外 restart；MERF 300 棵樹、leaf 5、特徵比例 0.5、迭代上限 25。GAMM 與 BART 採第 II.4 節的固定模型規格。

獨立全虛無校準與集合選取

15 個設計各建立 200 次匹配全虛無資料：直接生物標記效應設為零，保留因子分布、背景相依、相關誘餌、個體變異、缺失、退出與污染設定。對模型 mmm、設計 qqq，收集每次的最大重要性 Mmqr=max⁡jImqrjM_{mqr}=\max_j I_{mqrj}Mmqr​=maxj​Imqrj​，取 200 個值升序排列後的第 191 個值，再跨設計取最大值：

k=⌈(200+1)(1−0.05)⌉=191k=\left\lceil(200+1)(1-0.05)\right\rceil=191k=⌈(200+1)(1−0.05)⌉=191
λm=max⁡qmax⁡{0,Mmq,(191)}\lambda_m=\max_q\max\{0,M_{mq,(191)}\}λm​=qmax​max{0,Mmq,(191)​}
K^m={j:Imj>λm}\widehat K_m=\{j:I_{mj}>\lambda_m\}Km​={j:Imj​>λm​}

每模型凍結一個共同門檻。校準目標為指定全虛無合成族中至少選出一個因子的機率；驗證時按模型使用門檻，選取數量由重要性分數決定。

指標、整體結果與情境差異

以 KKK 為生成真因子集合，定義 TP=∣K^∩K∣TP=|\widehat K\cap K|TP=∣K∩K∣、FP=∣K^∖K∣FP=|\widehat K\setminus K|FP=∣K∖K∣。Recall 為 TP/∣K∣TP/|K|TP/∣K∣，FPR 為 FP/(14−∣K∣)FP/(14-|K|)FP/(14−∣K∣)，整組找回率為 Pr⁡(K^=K)\Pr(\widehat K=K)Pr(K=K)；至少一次誤選率以 FP>0FP>0FP>0 計算。整體 Recall 與整組找回率對 14 個有訊號設計、共 2,800 次驗證逐次取平均。整體 pooled Precision 使用 15 個設計的總真陽性除以總選取數：

Precision⁡pooled=∑rTPr∑r(TPr+FPr)\operatorname{Precision}_{\mathrm{pooled}}=\frac{\sum_r TP_r}{\sum_r(TP_r+FP_r)}Precisionpooled​=∑r​(TPr​+FPr​)∑r​TPr​​

S9 顯示整體平均之外的辨識差異。MERF 至少一次誤選率為 23.5%、RF 為 21.5%、BART 為 7.0%、GAMM 為 3.5%。依 S9 自身的選取數計算，BART 有 TP=18TP=18TP=18、FP=14FP=14FP=14，pooled Precision 為 56.25%；MERF 為 97/(97+47)=67.36%97/(97+47)=67.36\%97/(97+47)=67.36%，GAMM 為 12/(12+7)=63.16%12/(12+7)=63.16\%12/(12+7)=63.16%。本研究因此並列整體與逐情境指標，用以描述訊號找回、選取頻率及誤選之間的取捨。

II.3 方向可靠度：控制情境、風險校準與驗證

方向情境與共同證據

Direction 使用 50 個體、四次訪視與三折個體交叉擬合，延用第一部分的背景控制、生成式與殘差證據。每個模型在各外折擬合四個迴歸：以控制變數 CCC 預測 A／B，以及加入另一變數後的完整模型。以 ID 等權 RMSE 計算兩個方向的增額預測 gain，並由交叉擬合殘差計算 kernel margin。

gA→B=RMSE⁡B∼C−RMSE⁡B∼C+ARMSE⁡B∼Cg_{A\to B}=\frac{\operatorname{RMSE}_{B\sim C}-\operatorname{RMSE}_{B\sim C+A}}{\operatorname{RMSE}_{B\sim C}}gA→B​=RMSEB∼C​RMSEB∼C​−RMSEB∼C+A​​
gˉ=gA→B+gB→A2\bar g=\frac{g_{A\to B}+g_{B\to A}}{2}gˉ​=2gA→B​+gB→A​​

所有門檻共用同一份已擬合證據。可定向情境的生成方向與正負號涵蓋四種組合；校準時等機率獨立抽取，驗證時依預定循環分配。

表 II.3．方向研究的生成條件與階段
情境生成條件本輪用途
D0調整控制變數後，沒有額外的直接關係。控制校準、獨立驗證。
D1線性高斯生成、訊號係數 0.60；依本研究識別假設歸入方向未定控制。控制校準、獨立驗證。
D2線性關係、非高斯創新項；訊號係數 0.60。可定向校準混合、獨立驗證、性能比較。
D3平滑非線性關係；訊號係數 0.60。可定向校準混合、獨立驗證、性能比較。
D4連續斜率轉折；訊號係數 0.60、轉折位置 0.25。可定向校準混合、獨立驗證、性能比較。
D5弱平滑非線性關係；訊號係數 0.30。可定向校準混合、獨立驗證。
D6平滑關係、訊號係數 0.60；個體異質性提高至 ICC 0.55。可定向校準混合、獨立驗證、性能比較。
D7觀測到的共同原因，直接關係為零。控制校準、獨立驗證。
D8隱藏共同原因，直接關係為零。控制校準、獨立驗證。
D9平滑關係、訊號係數 0.60；MAR 缺失 20%、個體退出 20%、離群污染 5%。可定向校準混合、獨立驗證、性能比較。
D10來源變數的斜率隨修飾變數改變；訊號係數 0.60、修飾轉折 0.25、修飾強度 0.80。可定向校準混合、獨立驗證、性能比較。
D11高個體變異的匹配虛無情境；ICC 0.55、直接關係為零。控制校準。
D12匹配虛無情境；缺失 20%、個體退出 20%、離群污染 5%。控制校準。

校準門檻與風險要求

每模型的獨立校準資料為六個控制情境各 300 次，以及 2,100 次可定向情境混合。混合每次等機率抽取 D2、D3、D4、D5、D6、D9、D10。gain 候選為 0、0.01、0.025、0.05、0.10、0.15、0.20；margin 候選為 0.05、0.10、0.20、0.30、0.50、0.75、0.90、0.99，共 56 組。

每組候選要求可定向校準案例至少出箭頭 30 次；出箭頭時的條件錯向風險上界不超過 10%；各控制情境的假箭頭與 invalid 合計事件上界不超過 5%；整體 invalid 比例亦不超過 5%。上界採單側 Clopper–Pearson，信賴水準 95%，對每模型的 56 組候選及七項風險限制作 392 項 Bonferroni 校正。通過的候選以方向出箭頭率最大者凍結；無通過候選時凍結棄權規則。

Coverage⁡=NissuedNeligible\operatorname{Coverage}=\frac{N_{\mathrm{issued}}}{N_{\mathrm{eligible}}}Coverage=Neligible​Nissued​​
Directional Precision⁡=NcorrectNissued\operatorname{Directional\ Precision}=\frac{N_{\mathrm{correct}}}{N_{\mathrm{issued}}}Directional Precision=Nissued​Ncorrect​​
False Arrow Rate⁡=Ncontrol, issuedNcontrol, eligible\operatorname{False\ Arrow\ Rate}=\frac{N_{\mathrm{control,\ issued}}}{N_{\mathrm{control,\ eligible}}}False Arrow Rate=Ncontrol, eligible​Ncontrol, issued​​

方向 Coverage 與 Precision 以七個可定向情境計算；假箭頭率以控制情境計算。驗證每模型包含 1,400 次可定向案例與 800 次控制案例。比例表列事件數、分母與描述性 Wilson 區間。

七個非固定常數模型的 56 組候選均未通過全部風險要求，因此與 Mean 一同保留棄權規則。八模型的校準與驗證 evidence invalid 數均為零。驗證中，各凍結規則的出箭頭率為 0，箭頭正確率因分母為零而留空。GAMM 在通過全部控制檢核的候選中最多出箭頭 13 次，BART 為 8 次；兩者皆不足預先設定的 30 次。

固定網格的診斷亦描述風險限制的來源。MERF 的最小條件錯向風險上界為 29.30%，對應 127 次箭頭中的 19 次反向；BART 為 35.16%，對應 126 次中的 25 次反向；GAMM 為 46.60%，對應 1,396 次中的 582 次反向。這些列是校準網格摘要，正式驗證使用各自凍結的棄權規則。

II.4 模型規格與同資料性能比較

平滑混合模型與貝葉斯樹模型

GAMM 以 Gaussian 加法混合模型表示連續變數的平滑效果、二元變數與缺失指示的線性效果，以及個體隨機截距。令 zitz_{it}zit​ 為線性項，C\mathcal CC 為連續變數集合：

Yit=zitTβ+∑j∈Cfj(Xjit)+bi+εitY_{it}=z_{it}^{\mathsf T}\beta+\sum_{j\in\mathcal C}f_j(X_{jit})+b_i+\varepsilon_{it}Yit​=zitT​β+j∈C∑​fj​(Xjit​)+bi​+εit​

各平滑項使用中心化 cubic P-spline，knots 為 3、degree 為 3；採二階差分懲罰，null-space 收縮係數為 0.1。所有平滑項共享一個平滑變異，個體截距與殘差各有變異參數，以 profiled marginal REML 擬合，最佳化上限為 100 次。

BART 使用 StochTree 0.4.5 的 Gaussian 樹加總與個體隨機截距聯合後驗抽樣：

Yit=∑h=150gh(Xit;Th,θh)+bi+εitY_{it}=\sum_{h=1}^{50}g_h(X_{it};T_h,\theta_h)+b_i+\varepsilon_{it}Yit​=h=1∑50​gh​(Xit​;Th​,θh​)+bi​+εit​
  • 50 棵樹、葉節點至少 5 筆；樹分裂先驗參數 alpha 0.95、beta 2。
  • 4 次 GFR 初始化、2 條 MCMC 鏈；每鏈暖機 1,000 次，再抽樣 1,000 次，每 5 次保留一次；合計保留 400 個後驗樣本。
  • 以殘差變異與最多 12 個固定訓練點的預測計算 classical split R^\widehat RR，1.1 為旗標門檻。
  • 若訓練鏈診斷帶旗標，依預先規定以相同種子延長一次：暖機 2,000 次、抽樣 4,000 次、每 10 次保留一次；兩鏈合計 800 個樣本。最終帶旗標的擬合仍納入評分。

GAMM 與 BART 各採一個預先固定的結構規格，參數由各訓練資料估計。兩者母體預測使用固定／平滑部分或樹函數的估計值；已知個體另加入估計隨機截距，新個體的額外截距取零。

Core：新個體與已知個體的預測

性能組使用 S2、S6、F3、S9，各 50 次，與原 GPR、LMM、MERF 基準逐次共享訓練、測試與評分亂數流。新個體任務以 2,000 個獨立生成個體評估母體預測。已知個體任務保留具有至少兩次觀測者的最後一次可觀測訪視，以其歷史資料訓練，預測時使用當次共變數；混合模型可使用歷史估計的個體截距。

RMSE⁡r=1Nr∑ℓ=1Nr(Yrℓ−Y^rℓ)2\operatorname{RMSE}_r=\sqrt{\frac{1}{N_r}\sum_{\ell=1}^{N_r}(Y_{r\ell}-\widehat Y_{r\ell})^2}RMSEr​=Nr​1​ℓ=1∑Nr​​(Yrℓ​−Yrℓ​)2​

觀測 RMSE 對實際生成後的結果評分。Latent RMSE 另外以生成器的母體條件平均作新個體目標、以包含個體截距的條件平均作已知個體目標。表中每個情境平均值的 Monte Carlo 分母為 50。

函數重建：已知生成因子與方向下的評分

Core 的曲線組對生成真因子計算 ALE，以獨立測試資料的參考共變數比較模型曲線與生成真曲線；每次先在真因子間平均，再對 50 次重複彙整。Core 性能組亦保留以生成母體平均評分的重要性排序與已知真因子數的 top-kkk 指標，作為函數與排序能力的研究量。第 II.2 節的集合選取另依觀測結果與凍結門檻評估。

EALE,r=1sr1J∑j=1J(A^rj−Arj)2E_{\mathrm{ALE},r}=\frac{1}{s_r}\sqrt{\frac{1}{J}\sum_{j=1}^{J}(\widehat A_{rj}-A_{rj})^2}EALE,r​=sr​1​J1​j=1∑J​(Arj​−Arj​)2​

Core 的 srs_rsr​ 為參考資料乾淨結果的標準差。Direction 的函數組採已知生成方向作評分條件，使用該方向的交叉擬合模型、獨立生成參考資料與訓練來源變數第 5–95 百分位範圍。中心化 PD 比較直接結構曲線；ALE 依區間質量加權，尺度為參考目標變數的標準差。

EALE,rDirection=1sr∑jqj(A^rj−Arj)2E_{\mathrm{ALE},r}^{\mathrm{Direction}}=\frac{1}{s_r}\sqrt{\sum_j q_j(\widehat A_{rj}-A_{rj})^2}EALE,rDirection​=sr​1​j∑​qj​(Arj​−Arj​)2​

D4 另記錄候選轉折與位置誤差；D10 比較修飾變數切片、純交互作用對比及條件曲面。這組評分固定生成因子或生成方向，逐項衡量函數重建品質。

II.5 數值最佳化與擬合診斷

數值比較固定各 replicate 的資料、測試集合與亂數流，Core 先由訓練資料選定基準 kernel 或森林結構，再比較數值控制。Direction 固定模型結構與既定方向門檻。對每項性能指標先計算變體減基準的逐次差，再彙整平均、變動幅度與有效配對數。

LMM 的 Core 與 Direction 最終擬合收斂旗標皆為 True。基準使用備援求解器的比例，Core 新個體為 75.5%、已追蹤個體為 77.0%、Direction 為 77.33%。更換求解器後，Core 新個體平均 RMSE 差約為 2.5×10−62.5\times10^{-6}2.5×10−6，最大絕對差約 0.000403；Direction 決策狀態改變 2／300 次。

MERF 由 25 次延長至 100 次後，Core 新個體平均 RMSE 差為 −0.0000270，絕對差第 95 百分位約 0.000247；Direction 達迭代上限的比例由 44.22% 降至 17.31%，GLL 停止條件達成率由 57.25% 增至 82.89%。迭代上限與停止條件分別記錄，最後一次迭代可同時符合兩項。

GPR 放寬 length scale 界限後，新個體平均 RMSE 差為 +0.001399，絕對差第 95 百分位為 0.05963，最大為 0.16167；200 次中有 183 次的候選因子排名發生變動。Core 的寬界限與額外 5 次重啟預測相同：各擬合的六個最佳化起點皆以原始起點取得最佳解。這組結果將核參數邊界、整體預測變動與因子排名敏感度分別量化。

II.6 結果如何形成後續分析策略

本輪結果支持按分析目標保留不同候選方法，並在訓練資料內完成最終策略選擇。

  • 因子篩選：MERF 與 RF 保留為主要候選，兩者在有訊號設計的平均 Recall 與整組找回率居前。相關誘餌與污染情境則同時檢視逐情境 Precision、至少一次誤選與選取數。BART、GAM 與 GPR 的結果提供其他回收率與誤選組合，便於比較篩選規則的取捨。
  • 新個體預測：BART 保留為預測候選，與 MERF 作相同個體切分下的比較。S2、S6、F3 的配對結果支持其較低平均觀測 RMSE；S9 的平均差與區間另列，已知個體任務則獨立評估。
  • 平滑結構敏感度：GAMM 保留為具共享平滑變異與隨機截距的敏感度模型，用以比較加法結構下的預測、函數曲線及估計穩定度。
  • 方向呈現：本次風險校準保留棄權。後續資料分析以調整後關聯、雙向增額預測資訊與曲線形狀呈現變數關係，方向證據另外報告其規則、coverage 與適用的模擬情境。

實作時先依目標設定新個體或已知個體任務，於訓練資料內以個體分組交叉驗證比較模型、參數與篩選程序。評分折完整保留個體，並對整套前處理、選參與變項選取程序重新擬合。最終保留個體提供預先指定指標的評估，模型選擇過程及變項穩定度一同記錄。

這份模擬的主要產出，是在明確生成條件下量化每項分析程序的回收、誤選、預測與數值表現；依任務保留候選方法，再以訓練資料內的評估確定研究分析方案。

01 Research questions and formal scope

This benchmark compares six regression methods on small longitudinal samples. Two simulations use known data-generating mechanisms to assess factor ranking, response functions, prediction, and evidence about the direction of a relationship between two variables. Each task has its own evaluation target. All formal scenarios and model results are reported by task.

1.1 Questions addressed by the two studies

Study I (Core) asks whether a model can recover the factors that directly enter the outcome equation among 14 candidates, reconstruct linear and nonlinear response functions, detect slope changes and effect modification, and predict outcomes for new individuals or individuals with an observed history.

Study II (Direction) asks whether A and B provide incremental predictive information after adjustment, when a shared evidence procedure issues A→BA\to BA→B or B→AB\to AB→A, and when it retains an unresolved direction. Response curves and effect modification are evaluated separately, conditional on the known generating direction.

Table 1. Formal result sets and computational scope
ItemStudy I: CoreStudy II: Direction
Formal versionbenchmark_v2direction_v1 / validation
Main design50 individuals × 4 visits; five additional sample configurations50 individuals × 4 visits
Formal scenarios10 main scenarios + 5 sample sensitivity settings = 15D0–D10 = 11

Prespecified precision checks484/484 passed138/138 passed
Final failures / invalid results0 failed final model tasks0 invalid direction results; 0 invalid curve results

A replicate consists of newly generated data, model fitting, and evaluation. All six models share the data and evaluation conditions within a replicate, allowing paired comparisons. The counts above include formal results only; development, calibration, and supplementary diagnostics are described separately.

This simulation study forms part of the author’s project in collaboration with National Taiwan University Hospital, but uses no patient information. All data used in the simulations are synthetic. This page presents their generating mechanisms, evaluation methods, and aggregate results.

02 Compared methods and shared implementation

2.1 Six regression methods

  • Mean: predicts the mean of the training outcome.
  • LMM: combines linear fixed effects and individual random intercepts; estimated individual effects are used when a history is available.
  • GAM: estimates response functions with additive spline bases and a ridge penalty.
  • RF: averages predictions from regression trees.
  • GPR: uses a kernel to describe input similarity and estimate the response function.
  • MERF: alternates between a forest fixed component and individual random intercepts; estimated individual effects are used when a history is available.
Table 2. Model specifications actually compared

MERF stops early at relative GLL change 0.001. The GAM implementation is additive spline–ridge regression. LMM and GAM receive no additional true interaction term.

2.2 Common information and grouping by individual

Models share each generated dataset, grouped splits, and reference data. ID defines grouping, random effects, and evaluation. Median imputation, missingness indicators, feature scaling, and target scaling are learned within the relevant training data and then applied to held-out data. True factor lists, curves, and arrows are unavailable during fitting.

All models share the data and available information. Model flexibility, computational cost, and Study I forest sizes follow Table 2. The RF–MERF comparison evaluates the full model specifications rather than an experiment that varies only the random intercept.

03 Study I: design for factor, function, and prediction recovery

3.3 Response functions, decoys, missingness, and contamination

Three base functions

hlinear(x)=x,hsmooth(x)=0.8sin⁡(πx/2)+0.2(x2−1),hhinge(x)=max⁡(0,x−0.25).\begin{aligned}h_{\mathrm{linear}}(x)&=x,\\[0.9em]h_{\mathrm{smooth}}(x)&=0.8\sin(\pi x/2)+0.2(x^2-1),\\[0.9em]h_{\mathrm{hinge}}(x)&=\max(0,x-0.25).\end{aligned}hlinear​(x)hsmooth​(x)hhinge​(x)​=x,=0.8sin(πx/2)+0.2(x2−1),=max(0,x−0.25).​

Centering and standardization

h~q(x)=hq(x)−E[hq(G)]SD⁡[hq(G)],G∼N(0,1),q∈{linear,smooth,hinge}.\begin{aligned}\widetilde h_q(x)&=\frac{h_q(x)-\mathbb{E}[h_q(G)]}{\operatorname{SD}[h_q(G)]},\\[0.9em]G&\sim\mathcal{N}(0,1),\qquad q\in\{\mathrm{linear},\mathrm{smooth},\mathrm{hinge}\}.\end{aligned}hq​(x)G​=SD[hq​(G)]hq​(x)−E[hq​(G)]​,∼N(0,1),q∈{linear,smooth,hinge}.​

The outcome equation uses standardized functions such as h~smooth\widetilde h_{\mathrm{smooth}}hsmooth​ and h~hinge\widetilde h_{\mathrm{hinge}}hhinge​, multiplied by the scenario coefficient. Centering and scaling constants use deterministic 64-point Gauss–Hermite quadrature. Actual X distributions remain those generated above. Realized signal variance and R2R^2R2 depend on both function shape and input distribution. In S4 the first function is multiplied by (1+0.75DM)(1+0.75\mathrm{DM})(1+0.75DM), and the second is linear. The default second coefficient is 2/3 of the first; F1 uses 0.35 and F3 uses 0.50.

A decoy is D=rX~+1−r2 E~D=r\widetilde X+\sqrt{1-r^2}\,\widetilde ED=rX+1−r2​E, where X~\widetilde XX is the sample-standardized first factor and E~\widetilde EE is orthogonal to X~\widetilde XX in the complete sample. The generator sets r as an exact sample correlation before missingness. Decoys do not enter μ\muμ directly.

In F3 and S9, each candidate-factor cell is missing with probability p=clip⁡(0.20[0.55+0.70DM+0.45late],0.01,0.65)p=\operatorname{clip}(0.20[0.55+0.70\mathrm{DM}+0.45\mathrm{late}],0.01,0.65)p=clip(0.20[0.55+0.70DM+0.45late],0.01,0.65), where late denotes the second half of visits. This MAR mechanism depends on observed DM and time; it does not mask the outcome. A fixed random 20% of IDs lose their second-half visits: the 50×4 design retains 180 of 200 rows and all 50 IDs. S9 selects a fixed 5% of scheduled rows for positive Uniform⁡(2,3)\operatorname{Uniform}(2,3)Uniform(2,3) contamination before outcome clipping and visit retention.

3.4 All main scenarios and sample sensitivity settings

All ten main scenarios and five sensitivity configurations below have completed formal simulation. Each block lists generating conditions, the research objective, and results. Complete model values appear in Section 4.

S0 No additional biomarker signalR=200R = 200R=200

Purpose
Check whether models produce spurious biomarker importance or response curves when there is no true biomarker effect.
Conditions
Training data contain 50 synthetic individuals with 4 visits each, giving 200 scheduled observations at months 3, 6, 9, and 12. There are 14 candidate biomarkers and 8 shared background variables. There are no true biomarkers: every direct biomarker coefficient is zero, while the shared background effects remain. The ICC parameter for the random-intercept and residual components is 0.25; the residual SD is 0.70. No highly correlated decoy variables are imposed. No biomarker missingness, visit dropout, or additional outlier contamination is imposed. Observed outcomes are clipped to [0,8][0,8][0,8] by the common generator.
Interpretation
The S0 prediction target retains the shared background effects. Evaluation covers prediction error and importance assigned to biomarkers with zero direct effects. Exact recovery and true-factor curve error are recorded as not applicable because the truth set is empty.
Result tables →

3.5 Complete workflow within a replicate

  1. Generate common training data and an independent test set. The test set has 2,000 new IDs. Both datasets receive the specified missingness, dropout, and contamination.
  2. Select settings within training data. GAM, RF, GPR, and MERF use 3-fold GroupKFold and ID-balanced MSE. The best candidate is refitted on all training data. Mean and LMM have one candidate and no candidate search.
  3. Predict new individuals. Models use the common test set; LMM/MERF use zero individual effects for new IDs. The primary latent target is μ\muμ. Observed RMSE, MAE, and R2R^2R2 are retained separately.
  4. Evaluate factors and functions. The complete latent test data for the first 250 IDs provide an oracle evaluation reference. ID-trajectory permutation is repeated three times per candidate. Model and true ALE use 20 quantile bins.
  5. Evaluate individuals with history. Hold out the last observed visit of each eligible training ID. Retune and refit using earlier history. Supply current X at the held-out visit; LMM/MERF may use the ID's estimated effect. The latent target is μ+b\mu+bμ+b.
  6. Save and aggregate. Retain metrics, warnings, and completion status. Compute means and MCSE across replicates, pairing model differences within the same replicate.

3.6 Mathematical definitions of the metrics

For true factor set KrK_rKr​ and the top-kkk importance set TrT_rTr​, define Er=1{Tr=Kr}E_r=\mathbf{1}\{T_r=K_r\}Er​=1{Tr​=Kr​}, with k=∣Kr∣k=|K_r|k=∣Kr​∣. Exact recovery is 1R∑r=1REr\frac{1}{R}\sum_{r=1}^{R}E_rR1​∑r=1R​Er​. Importance is the permutation increase in MSE against μ\muμ, divided by clean outcome variance. AP summarizes true-factor positions in the complete ranking. Family recovery allows a designated same-family decoy to represent a signal source. These ranking metrics are undefined for S0, with k=0k=0k=0, and for Mean.

Standardized ALE error

ALEerrorr,kCore=1J∑j=1J(A^r,k,j−Ar,k,j)2sY,r.\mathrm{ALEerror}^{\mathrm{Core}}_{r,k}=\frac{\sqrt{\frac{1}{J}\sum_{j=1}^{J}(\widehat A_{r,k,j}-A_{r,k,j})^2}}{s_{Y,r}}.ALEerrorr,kCore​=sY,r​J1​∑j=1J​(Ar,k,j​−Ar,k,j​)2​​.

Latent RMSE for new individuals

LatentRMSErnew=1n∑i,t(y^it−μit)2.\mathrm{LatentRMSE}^{\mathrm{new}}_r=\sqrt{\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i,t}(\widehat y_{it}-\mu_{it})^2}.LatentRMSErnew​=n1​i,t∑​(y​it​−μit​)2​.

A^\widehat AA and A are centered model and true ALE curves. Centering uses bin counts, while the error gives equal weight to valid grid points. The denominator sY,rs_{Y,r}sY,r​ is the SD of the complete clean reference outcome. Two-factor errors are averaged within a replicate before aggregation. The known-ID task replaces μ\muμ by μ+b\mu+bμ+b. Primary latent RMSE weights retained evaluation rows equally; ID-balanced observed-error variants are also available in the download.

For S4, 15 first-factor quantiles between the 5th and 95th percentiles crossed with DM∈{0,1}\mathrm{DM}\in\{0,1\}DM∈{0,1} yield 30 combinations. Predictions and truth are averaged over common reference data, centered over the entire surface, compared by RMSE, and divided by sY,rs_{Y,r}sY,r​. This metric evaluates the complete joint response surface, including main effects.

The five scientific models attain 100% in S1, S2, S3, and S6. In S4 all attain 100% except GPR at 99.5%. Factor ranking is near its ceiling in these settings, while function and prediction errors still differ. F1 results are GAM 94.9%, MERF 93.5%, RF 92.4%, LMM 76.4%, and GPR 40.7%. RF has the highest F2 mean at 83.3%, followed by MERF at 81.5%. Four models attain 100% family recovery while exact recovery is about 66%–83%, revealing difficulty distinguishing a direct factor from highly correlated substitutes. GAM has the highest mean in F3 (75.3%) and S9 (53.3%). All methods miss factors under combined difficulties.

05 Study II: design for direction and response shape

5.1 Synthetic source, target, and common causes

Each replicate has 50 IDs and visits at months 3, 6, 9, and 12. SSS denotes the generating source and TTT its target; displayed labels A/B alternate across replicates. The adjustment set is C=(MonthScaled,Age,Sex,DM,HTN,CKD,Z)C=(\mathrm{MonthScaled},\mathrm{Age},\mathrm{Sex},\mathrm{DM},\mathrm{HTN},\mathrm{CKD},Z)C=(MonthScaled,Age,Sex,DM,HTN,CKD,Z).

Source variable

Sit=0.20mit+0.10Agei−6010+0.15DMi+cit+rS,i+eS,it.\begin{aligned}S_{it}&=0.20m_{it}+0.10\frac{\mathrm{Age}_i-60}{10}+0.15\mathrm{DM}_i\\[0.9em]&\quad+c_{it}+r_{S,i}+e_{S,it}.\end{aligned}Sit​​=0.20mit​+0.1010Agei​−60​+0.15DMi​+cit​+rS,i​+eS,it​.​

Target variable

Tit=−0.10mit+0.10Agei−6010+0.15CKDi+cit+f(Sit,Zit)+0.70(rT,i+eT,it).\begin{aligned}T_{it}&=-0.10m_{it}+0.10\frac{\mathrm{Age}_i-60}{10}+0.15\mathrm{CKD}_i\\[0.9em]&\quad+c_{it}+f(S_{it},Z_{it})+0.70(r_{T,i}+e_{T,it}).\end{aligned}Tit​​=−0.10mit​+0.1010Agei​−60​+0.15CKDi​+cit​+f(Sit​,Zit​)+0.70(rT,i​+eT,it​).​

Here r=ρ ξIDr=\sqrt\rho\,\xi_{\mathrm{ID}}r=ρ​ξID​ and e=1−ρ ξrowe=\sqrt{1-\rho}\,\xi_{\mathrm{row}}e=1−ρ​ξrow​. Ordinary ξ\xiξ terms are independent standard Gaussian draws; in D2 both individual and row terms are Laplace⁡(0,1)/2\operatorname{Laplace}(0,1)/\sqrt 2Laplace(0,1)/2​, preserving unit variance. Total source noise scale is 1 and target noise scale is 0.70. The parameter ρ\rhoρ is ordinarily 0.25 and 0.55 in D6. D1 matches source/target longitudinal noise correlation structures, with different absolute noise scales. Z uses a separate noise pair with the same ρ\rhoρ and total scale 1.

5.3 Three-fold cross-fitting and directional evidence

  1. Use common complete A/B rows. Direction analysis uses complete pairs without imputing missing targets. Models and both directions share those rows.
  2. Split by ID into three folds. Each training split fits A∼CA\sim CA∼C, B∼CB\sim CB∼C, A∼C+BA\sim C+BA∼C+B, and B∼C+AB\sim C+AB∼C+A. Transformations use training-fold information only. Held-out-ID LMM/MERF predictions do not use estimated effects for that ID.
  3. Combine out-of-fold predictions. A row from ID i with viv_ivi​ complete visits has weight wit=1NIDviw_{it}=\frac{1}{N_{\mathrm{ID}}v_i}wit​=NID​vi​1​, giving each individual equal total weight.
  4. Calculate incremental gain and residual dependence. Relative RMSE improvements measure additional information. Residual kernel alignment in the two directions provides a margin.
  5. Apply thresholds frozen before validation. Retain no incremental relationship detected, unresolved direction, A→BA\to BA→B, B→AB\to AB→A, or invalid, together with continuous gains and margins.
  6. Evaluate shape separately. The known generating direction and 200 independently generated clean reference IDs are used only for curve scoring.

Directional incremental prediction gain

gA→B=RMSEB∼C−RMSEB∼C+ARMSEB∼C.g_{A\to B}=\frac{\mathrm{RMSE}_{B\sim C}-\mathrm{RMSE}_{B\sim C+A}}{\mathrm{RMSE}_{B\sim C}}.gA→B​=RMSEB∼C​RMSEB∼C​−RMSEB∼C+A​​.

Mean gain across directions

gˉ=gA→B+gB→A2.\bar g=\frac{g_{A\to B}+g_{B\to A}}{2}.gˉ​=2gA→B​+gB→A​​.

Directional margin

m=HB→A−HA→BHB→A+HA→B.m=\frac{H_{B\to A}-H_{A\to B}}{H_{B\to A}+H_{A\to B}}.m=HB→A​+HA→B​HB→A​−HA→B​​.

RMSE uses the ID-balanced weights above. HA→BH_{A\to B}HA→B​ is normalized kernel alignment between A−A^baseA-\widehat A_{\mathrm{base}}A−Abase​ and B−B^fullB-\widehat B_{\mathrm{full}}B−Bfull​; the reverse direction is analogous. Gaussian residual kernels are centered with the weights, giving:

H=∑i,jwiwjK~ijL~ij(∑i,jwiwjK~ij 2)(∑i,jwiwjL~ij 2)H=\frac{\sum_{i,j}w_iw_j\widetilde K_{ij}\widetilde L_{ij}}{\sqrt{\left(\sum_{i,j}w_iw_j\widetilde K_{ij}^{\,2}\right)\left(\sum_{i,j}w_iw_j\widetilde L_{ij}^{\,2}\right)}}H=(∑i,j​wi​wj​Kij2​)(∑i,j​wi​wj​Lij2​)​∑i,j​wi​wj​Kij​Lij​​

Kernel scales use median positive squared distances.

If gˉ≤g0\bar g\le g_0gˉ​≤g0​, the output is no_edge. Incremental information with inadequate margin, or an abstain-only rule, produces unresolved. A→BA\to BA→B requires m>m0m>m_0m>m0​ and gA→B>0g_{A\to B}>0gA→B​>0; B→AB\to AB→A requires m<−m0m<-m_0m<−m0​ and positive reverse gain. Insufficient data or numerical failure is invalid.

5.4 Calibration, matched nulls, and frozen rules

Calibration first used 11×30=330 replicates. D11, a high-heterogeneity null, and D12, a null with D9 data-quality difficulties, contributed 60 more. Ten additional D6 and ten D11 replicates filled a less common observable group, giving 410 calibration replicates for the final freeze. D11/D12 are calibration supplements; formal validation contains D0–D10 and 2,350 replicates.

Observable groups are assigned sequentially: pair missing fraction>0.15>0.15>0.15 or median complete visits<3<3<3 defines missing/sparse; otherwise an individual-mean variance / total variance ratio>0.65>0.65>0.65 defines high between-ID variation; remaining data are ordinary. The ratio is the larger value for A/B. Final freezing uses D0/D1/D7 for ordinary safety controls, D11 for high-variation controls, and D12 for sparse controls. Each group's calibration false-arrow or invalid rate must be ≤0.05\le0.05≤0.05 before maximizing group-balanced correct direction. D8 is retained as a hidden-confounding stress, excluded from final hard safety controls.

The gain grid is {0,0.01,0.025,0.05,0.10}\{0,0.01,0.025,0.05,0.10\}{0,0.01,0.025,0.05,0.10}; the margin grid is {0.05,0.10,0.20,0.30,0.50,0.75}\{0.05,0.10,0.20,0.30,0.50,0.75\}{0.05,0.10,0.20,0.30,0.50,0.75}. Each group/model requires at least 20 safety controls and 20 direction-eligible calibration cases. Frozen individual-model (g0,m0)(g_0,m_0)(g0​,m0​) values are LMM (0.05,0.50), GAM (0.01,0.20), RF (0.01,0.30), GPR (0.01,0.50), and MERF (0.01,0.30). Mean only abstains. A separate policy selects direction/shape engines using observable groups. Validation and calibration data seeds do not overlap; thresholds were not adjusted after observing final validation results.

5.5 Curves, slope changes, and effect modification

Predictions from the three full regressions in the true direction are averaged. Centered PD is evaluated at 41 source points between training quantiles 5% and 95%, using up to 64 deterministically, uniformly selected clean reference rows per point. ALE uses 12 quantile bins. Reference rows determine bin masses qjq_jqj​; local differences accumulate to bin midpoints and are centered using these masses.

Bin-mass-weighted ALE error

ALEerrorrDirection=∑jqj(A^r,j−Ar,j)2sT,r.\mathrm{ALEerror}^{\mathrm{Direction}}_r=\frac{\sqrt{\sum_j q_j(\widehat A_{r,j}-A_{r,j})^2}}{s_{T,r}}.ALEerrorrDirection​=sT,r​∑j​qj​(Ar,j​−Ar,j​)2​​.

Conditional-curve contrast at high and low modifier levels

D(x)=P(x,Z=0.75)−P(x,Z=−0.50).D(x)=P(x,Z=0.75)-P(x,Z=-0.50).D(x)=P(x,Z=0.75)−P(x,Z=−0.50).

The denominator sT,rs_{T,r}sT,r​ is clean reference-target SD. Core weights grid errors equally, while Direction weights them by bin mass. Reference data and standardizing denominators follow the respective study designs. In D10 each P is first centered over source grid points before subtracting high/low Z curves, removing additive Z main effects. A conditional response surface is also evaluated across training Z quantiles 5%–95%.

D4 candidate knots minimize continuous-hinge least squares over interior points, leaving at least three grid points on each side. A knot requires at least 10% improvement over a linear fit. The tables report detection frequency and location error conditional on detection separately. D10 additionally fits a knot to the source Q0.25→Q0.75Q_{0.25}\to Q_{0.75}Q0.25​→Q0.75​ effect as a function of Z. These are shape diagnostics in synthetic coordinates.

Curve scores condition on the true direction to separate directional and functional ability. Formal bootstrap repetitions are 0. Curve confidence bands, coverage, and whole-individual resampling support were not validated.

07 Monte Carlo uncertainty, diagnostics, and limitations

7.1 Means, MCSE, and paired differences

Mean and Monte Carlo standard error

θˉ=1R∑r=1Rθr,MCSE⁡(θˉ)=SD⁡(θ1,…,θR)R.\begin{aligned}\bar\theta&=\frac{1}{R}\sum_{r=1}^{R}\theta_r,\\[0.9em]\operatorname{MCSE}(\bar\theta)&=\frac{\operatorname{SD}(\theta_1,\ldots,\theta_R)}{\sqrt R}.\end{aligned}θˉMCSE(θˉ)​=R1​r=1∑R​θr​,=R​SD(θ1​,…,θR​)​.​

Paired model difference and Monte Carlo interval

dr=θA,r−θB,r,CI0.95MC(dˉ)≈dˉ±1.96SD⁡(d)R.\begin{aligned}d_r&=\theta_{A,r}-\theta_{B,r},\\[0.9em]\mathrm{CI}^{\mathrm{MC}}_{0.95}(\bar d)&\approx\bar d\pm1.96\frac{\operatorname{SD}(d)}{\sqrt R}.\end{aligned}dr​CI0.95MC​(dˉ)​=θA,r​−θB,r​,≈dˉ±1.96R​SD(d)​.​

The replicate is the aggregation unit. Model differences are paired within each replicate. Two-factor curve errors are averaged within replicates before computing cross-replicate means and MCSE. Core tables report means and MCSE. Direction proportions use Wilson intervals, and continuous metrics use approximate MC intervals.

Each setting requires at least 200 replicates, with additions of 25 if needed and a ceiling of 500. The stopping condition is MCSE⁡≤0.03\operatorname{MCSE}\le0.03MCSE≤0.03 for main rates and MCSE⁡≤0.02\operatorname{MCSE}\le0.02MCSE≤0.02 for main standardized continuous metrics. Direction uses Jeffreys smoothing at 0/1 boundaries. Core uses sample MCSE, which equals zero when all outcomes agree. All 484 Core and 138 Direction prespecified main precision checks passed.

A rate difference of ±0.05\pm0.05±0.05 defines descriptive practical closeness. For continuous errors, Core aggregates replicate-relative (A−B)/B(A-B)/B(A−B)/B with a 5% margin, while Direction uses 0.05×max(the two mean errors). The MC intervals follow an exploratory analysis specification without multiplicity or sequential-stopping corrections.

7.2 Development, calibration, and seed overlap

Core used 450 development-pilot replicates, followed by small calibrations of F1/F2/F3 difficulty. Formal results use frozen benchmark_v2 settings. Among 3,350 formal replicates, 390 (11.6%) reuse development train/test/evaluation seed combinations. Development results are aggregated separately.

An existing sensitivity analysis excludes seed-overlap replicates and retains 2,960 completed results without refitting. The largest scenario/model mean changes are about 1.53 percentage points for exact recovery, 0.0100 for ALE, and 0.0084 for latent RMSE. Direction has zero data-seed overlap between calibration and validation. D11/D12 currently contribute only to calibration.

7.3 Valid outputs and numerical estimation quality

Zero final failures means that finite evaluation results were produced. In Core, GPR kernel-boundary rates are about 99.7%/98.7% for new/known-ID tasks, LMM fallback rates 82.5%/69.2%, and MERF maximum-iteration rates 7.9%/9.9%. Direction has 28,200 fold-specific fits per model; GPR boundaries occur in about 87.0%, LMM fallback in 81.6%, and MERF reaches its limit in 44.4%, with mean iterations about 17.96.

Model diagnostics record kernel boundaries, LMM fallback, MERF iteration counts, and stopping states. MERF uses relative GLL change 0.001 and a maximum of 25 iterations. Fits reaching the limit retain their finite evaluation results.

7.4 Evaluation scope and further work

  1. Factor selection.Core uses known true factor count k, latent μ\muμ, and complete reference factors for scoring. Null selection thresholds, FDR, and automatic choice of k remain to be developed.
  2. Correlation and common causes.Core uses ID-block permutation. Direction includes observed and hidden common-cause scenarios to quantify incremental prediction and directional rules under these conditions.
  3. Curve uncertainty.Formal Direction bootstrap=0\mathrm{bootstrap}=0bootstrap=0. Further work includes confidence-band coverage, whole-individual resampling, and grid sensitivity in knot searches.
  4. Longitudinal prediction.This study evaluates conditional prediction with current X supplied. Future-factor modeling and within-/between-individual effect decomposition are reserved for further work.
  5. Complete networks.The two studies currently evaluate recovery for one outcome and directional evidence for one A/B pair. Network recovery, model voting, and automatic model selection will be compared separately.

08 Public aggregates and traceable sources

Page values are generated from reviewed aggregate CSV files. The manifest records source and output SHA-256 hashes. TOML files provide synthetic data-generating settings, and the download links point to the website data package. Public versions of the complete source and execution environment are still being prepared.

Method references

Peters et al. (2014): causal identifiability with continuous additive noise models; Mooij et al. (2016): cause–effect benchmarks; Apley & Zhu (2020): ALE and predictor-effect visualization. This study implements the evaluation workflow using ID weighting, longitudinal cross-fitting, and synthetic-scenario calibration.

II.1 Part II | Eight-Model Comparison of Factor Selection, Direction Calibration, and Prediction

This study compares eight models on three questions: signal identification when the factor count is unknown, the accuracy of issued directional arrows, and the effects of model specification and numerical optimization on prediction and function recovery.

The eight models are Mean, LMM, GAM, RF, GPR, MERF, GAMM, and BART. Factor selection and direction calibration include all eight. The paired performance experiment includes five models: GPR, LMM, MERF, GAMM, and BART. Results are summarized within their prespecified scenarios, tasks, and denominators.

Paired experiments with 50 replicates use descriptive 95% Monte Carlo t intervals without multiplicity adjustment. Overall selection contrasts equally weight 14 fixed scenarios and use stratified paired MCSEs with normal intervals.

II.2 Factor Identification with Unknown Set Size

Synthetic scenarios and signal strength

Each dataset contains 14 candidate biomarkers. The main design has 50 subjects and four visits at months 3, 6, 9, and 12; two-visit designs use months 3 and 12. Unless specified otherwise, the random-intercept variance proportion is ρ=0.25\rho=0.25ρ=0.25, and residual standard deviation is 0.70. Background variables and the outcome generator follow the Core design in Part I.

In the table, aaa denotes the primary direct-factor coefficient. Each response shape is centered and standardized under a standard-normal input before multiplication by aaa. Secondary coefficients are specified separately. S3 and S9 use a continuous hinge at 0.25. The two correlated decoys have the listed target correlations with the primary direct factor.

Importance based on observed outcomes

Subjects are partitioned into three outer folds. Each model is trained on the other subjects and scored on held-out subjects. Models with multiple candidate settings use three-fold subject-grouped validation within the outer training data. Median imputation, missingness indicators, scaling, and outcome scaling are estimated from the corresponding training data.

Training, tuning, and importance scoring use observed YYY. Model specifications for selection are: a constant Mean baseline; linear fixed effects and a random intercept for LMM; GAM knots 3/5 and ridge 1/10; RF with 300 trees, leaf size 5/10, and feature fraction 0.5; Matérn 3/2 GPR with no additional restart; and MERF with 300 trees, leaf size 5, feature fraction 0.5, and iteration cap 25. GAMM and BART use the fixed specifications in Section II.4.

Independent global-null calibration and set selection

Each of the 15 designs has 200 matched global-null calibration datasets. Direct biomarker effects are set to zero while preserving predictor distributions, background dependence, correlated decoys, subject variability, missingness, dropout, and contamination. For model mmm and design qqq, let Mmqr=max⁡jImqrjM_{mqr}=\max_j I_{mqrj}Mmqr​=maxj​Imqrj​. The 191st order statistic among 200 replicates is calculated for each design, and the largest nonnegative threshold is retained across designs:

k=⌈(200+1)(1−0.05)⌉=191k=\left\lceil(200+1)(1-0.05)\right\rceil=191k=⌈(200+1)(1−0.05)⌉=191
λm=max⁡qmax⁡{0,Mmq,(191)}\lambda_m=\max_q\max\{0,M_{mq,(191)}\}λm​=qmax​max{0,Mmq,(191)​}
K^m={j:Imj>λm}\widehat K_m=\{j:I_{mj}>\lambda_m\}Km​={j:Imj​>λm​}

One common threshold is frozen for each model. Calibration targets the probability of selecting at least one factor in the specified global-null synthetic family. Validation looks up the model-specific threshold, allowing the observed importance scores to determine the selected set size.

Metrics, overall results, and scenario differences

For the generating factor set KKK, define TP=∣K^∩K∣TP=|\widehat K\cap K|TP=∣K∩K∣ and FP=∣K^∖K∣FP=|\widehat K\setminus K|FP=∣K∖K∣. Recall is TP/∣K∣TP/|K|TP/∣K∣, false-positive rate is FP/(14−∣K∣)FP/(14-|K|)FP/(14−∣K∣), and exact recovery is Pr⁡(K^=K)\Pr(\widehat K=K)Pr(K=K). Any-false-positive frequency records FP>0FP>0FP>0. Overall recall and exact recovery average the replicate-level values across the 14 nonnull designs, giving 2,800 replicates. Overall pooled precision uses total true positives divided by total selections across all 15 designs:

Precision⁡pooled=∑rTPr∑r(TPr+FPr)\operatorname{Precision}_{\mathrm{pooled}}=\frac{\sum_r TP_r}{\sum_r(TP_r+FP_r)}Precisionpooled​=∑r​(TPr​+FPr​)∑r​TPr​​

The scenario tables also retain mean precision conditional on a nonempty selection and its effective denominator. Precision for an empty selection, and recall in S0, remain undefined. These denominators support comparisons of recovered, selected, and omitted factors.

II.3 Direction Reliability: Controls, Risk Calibration, and Validation

Direction scenarios and common evidence

Direction uses 50 subjects, four visits, and three-fold subject-grouped cross-fitting, following the controls, generator, and residual evidence in Part I. Each model fits four regressions per outer fold: A and B on controls CCC, and their corresponding full models that include the other variable. Two directional gains are calculated from subject-balanced RMSE, and a kernel margin is computed from cross-fitted residuals.

gA→B=RMSE⁡B∼C−RMSE⁡B∼C+ARMSE⁡B∼Cg_{A\to B}=\frac{\operatorname{RMSE}_{B\sim C}-\operatorname{RMSE}_{B\sim C+A}}{\operatorname{RMSE}_{B\sim C}}gA→B​=RMSEB∼C​RMSEB∼C​−RMSEB∼C+A​​
gˉ=gA→B+gB→A2\bar g=\frac{g_{A\to B}+g_{B\to A}}{2}gˉ​=2gA→B​+gB→A​​

All thresholds reuse the same fitted evidence. Four combinations of generating direction and effect sign are used in identifiable scenarios: sampled independently with equal probability in calibration, and assigned by a prespecified cycle in validation.

Calibration grid and risk requirements

Each model has 300 independent calibration replicates in each of the six controls and 2,100 identifiable-mixture replicates. The mixture independently samples D2, D3, D4, D5, D6, D9, or D10 with equal probability. Gain candidates are 0, 0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, and 0.20; margin candidates are 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.30, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90, and 0.99, yielding 56 pairs.

A candidate must issue at least 30 arrows on identifiable calibration cases, have an upper bound on conditional wrong-direction risk at most 10%, and have an upper bound on false-arrow-or-invalid risk at most 5% in every control scenario. Overall invalid frequency must also be at most 5%. Bounds are one-sided exact Clopper–Pearson bounds with confidence 95% and a within-model Bonferroni correction for 392 comparisons: 56 candidate pairs and seven risk constraints. Among feasible candidates, the rule with the largest directional coverage is frozen. If none is feasible, an abstention rule is frozen.

Coverage⁡=NissuedNeligible\operatorname{Coverage}=\frac{N_{\mathrm{issued}}}{N_{\mathrm{eligible}}}Coverage=Neligible​Nissued​​
Directional Precision⁡=NcorrectNissued\operatorname{Directional\ Precision}=\frac{N_{\mathrm{correct}}}{N_{\mathrm{issued}}}Directional Precision=Nissued​Ncorrect​​
False Arrow Rate⁡=Ncontrol, issuedNcontrol, eligible\operatorname{False\ Arrow\ Rate}=\frac{N_{\mathrm{control,\ issued}}}{N_{\mathrm{control,\ eligible}}}False Arrow Rate=Ncontrol, eligible​Ncontrol, issued​​

Directional coverage and precision use the seven identifiable scenarios; false-arrow rate uses controls. Each model has 1,400 identifiable and 800 control validation replicates. Proportion tables retain event counts, denominators, and descriptive Wilson intervals.

II.4 Model Specifications and Paired Performance

Smooth mixed models and Bayesian tree models

GAMM uses a Gaussian additive mixed model with smooth continuous-predictor effects, linear binary-predictor and missingness-indicator effects, and subject random intercepts. Let zitz_{it}zit​ collect linear terms and C\mathcal CC the continuous predictors:

Yit=zitTβ+∑j∈Cfj(Xjit)+bi+εitY_{it}=z_{it}^{\mathsf T}\beta+\sum_{j\in\mathcal C}f_j(X_{jit})+b_i+\varepsilon_{it}Yit​=zitT​β+j∈C∑​fj​(Xjit​)+bi​+εit​

Each smooth uses centered cubic P-splines with three knots and degree three, a second-difference penalty, and null-space shrinkage 0.1. Smooth terms share one smoothing variance, with separate subject-intercept and residual variances. Parameters are fitted using profiled marginal REML, with a maximum of 100 optimization iterations.

BART uses StochTree 0.4.5 for joint posterior sampling of a Gaussian sum of trees and subject random intercepts:

Yit=∑h=150gh(Xit;Th,θh)+bi+εitY_{it}=\sum_{h=1}^{50}g_h(X_{it};T_h,\theta_h)+b_i+\varepsilon_{it}Yit​=h=1∑50​gh​(Xit​;Th​,θh​)+bi​+εit​
  • 50 trees and minimum leaf size five; tree-splitting prior parameters alpha 0.95 and beta 2.
  • Four GFR initialization iterations and two MCMC chains. Each chain has 1,000 warm-up iterations followed by 1,000 sampling iterations, retaining every fifth draw for 400 posterior samples across chains.
  • Classical split R^\widehat RR for residual variance and predictions at up to 12 fixed training probes; 1.1 is the diagnostic threshold.
  • A prespecified training-diagnostic retry uses the same seed, with 2,000 warm-up and 4,000 sampling iterations per chain, retaining every tenth draw for 800 samples across chains. Fits with a final diagnostic flag remain in the evaluation.

GAMM and BART each use one prespecified structural specification, with parameters estimated from each training dataset. Population predictions use the estimated fixed/smooth component or posterior mean tree function. Known-subject predictions additionally include the estimated subject intercept; unseen subjects receive an added intercept of zero.

Core prediction for new and known subjects

The performance experiment uses S2, S6, F3, and S9, with 50 replicates each. Training, test, and evaluation random streams are paired with the original GPR, LMM, and MERF baselines. The new-subject task evaluates population predictions in 2,000 independently generated subjects. The known-subject task holds out the final available visit of subjects with at least two observations, trains on their histories, and uses covariates observed at the held-out visit. Mixed models can use subject intercepts estimated from those histories.

RMSE⁡r=1Nr∑ℓ=1Nr(Yrℓ−Y^rℓ)2\operatorname{RMSE}_r=\sqrt{\frac{1}{N_r}\sum_{\ell=1}^{N_r}(Y_{r\ell}-\widehat Y_{r\ell})^2}RMSEr​=Nr​1​ℓ=1∑Nr​​(Yrℓ​−Yrℓ​)2​

Observed RMSE scores the generated observed outcome. Latent RMSE separately targets the generating population conditional mean for new subjects and the conditional mean including subject intercepts for known subjects. Each scenario mean has a Monte Carlo denominator of 50.

Function recovery conditional on generating factors and direction

Core function evaluation computes ALE for the generating factors, comparing model and generating curves on reference covariates from the independent test data. Scores are first averaged across true factors within a replicate, then summarized across 50 replicates. The Core performance experiment also retains importance rankings scored against the generating population mean and top-kkk metrics using the known true factor count. These quantify function and ranking recovery. Set selection in Section II.2 is evaluated separately using observed outcomes and frozen thresholds.

EALE,r=1sr1J∑j=1J(A^rj−Arj)2E_{\mathrm{ALE},r}=\frac{1}{s_r}\sqrt{\frac{1}{J}\sum_{j=1}^{J}(\widehat A_{rj}-A_{rj})^2}EALE,r​=sr​1​J1​j=1∑J​(Arj​−Arj​)2​

For Core, srs_rsr​ is the standard deviation of the clean reference outcome. Direction function evaluation conditions on the generating direction, using the cross-fitted models in that direction, independently generated reference data, and the training source variable's 5th–95th percentile range. Centered PD is compared with the direct structural curve. ALE errors are weighted by interval mass and standardized by the reference target-variable standard deviation.

EALE,rDirection=1sr∑jqj(A^rj−Arj)2E_{\mathrm{ALE},r}^{\mathrm{Direction}}=\frac{1}{s_r}\sqrt{\sum_j q_j(\widehat A_{rj}-A_{rj})^2}EALE,rDirection​=sr​1​j∑​qj​(Arj​−Arj​)2​

D4 additionally records candidate knots and location errors. D10 evaluates modifier slices, pure interaction contrasts, and conditional surfaces. This experiment fixes the generating factors or direction to measure function recovery component by component.

Mean ALE error was lowest for GPR in D3, MERF in D4, and LMM in D9. In D10, LMM and GAMM had lower marginal ALE errors, while pure-interaction error was lowest for GPR at 0.1150, followed by MERF at 0.1495, BART at 0.1844, and GAMM and LMM at 0.2211. The GAMM specification is additive; marginal curves, conditional surfaces, and interaction contrasts are evaluated separately.

Candidate-knot detection follows the fitted-hinge rule. In D4, BART, MERF, GPR, and GAMM detected candidates in 50/50 replicates, with location MAEs of 0.2593, 0.2786, 0.3733, and 0.6500. LMM detected none. Location error is evaluated among replicates with a candidate and reported alongside detection frequency.

II.5 Numerical Optimization and Fit Diagnostics

The numerical experiment holds replicate data, test sets, and random streams fixed. Core first selects the baseline kernel or forest structure using training data, then varies numerical controls. Direction retains its original model structure and published decision thresholds. Each performance contrast is calculated within a replicate as variant minus baseline before summarizing means, changes, and available paired counts.

Table II.4. Prespecified numerical sensitivity variants
ModelBaselineVariants and records
GPRLength-scale bounds 0.01–100; one additional Core restart and zero additional Direction restarts.Bounds widened to 0.001–10000, followed by a five-restart variant. Records include bound hits for each kernel parameter, log marginal likelihood, parameter changes, and prediction changes.
LMML-BFGS first, Powell fallback, maximum 300 iterations.Powell first/L-BFGS fallback and BFGS first/Powell fallback, each with maximum 1,000 iterations. Records include final solver states, REML, subject-intercept variance, and parameter changes.
MERFIteration cap 25.Caps extended to 50 and 100 with the same relative GLL stopping threshold of 0.001. Iteration histories retain GLL, residual and random-effect variances, subject intercepts, and training-prediction changes.

A negative paired error contrast indicates lower error for the variant. Parameter, training-objective, and prediction changes are reported separately. When a baseline fit is unavailable, paired denominators reflect available results; other LMM solvers are still evaluated according to the prespecified procedure.

All final LMM fits in Core and Direction had a successful convergence flag. Baseline fallback use was 75.5% for new-subject Core prediction, 77.0% for known subjects, and 77.33% for Direction. Alternative solvers changed mean new-subject RMSE by approximately 2.5×10−62.5\times10^{-6}2.5×10−6, with maximum absolute change approximately 0.000403. Direction decision states changed in 2/300 replicates.

Extending MERF from 25 to 100 iterations changed mean new-subject RMSE by −0.0000270; the 95th percentile of absolute paired changes was approximately 0.000247. In Direction, the fraction reaching the iteration cap fell from 44.22% to 17.31%, while the fraction satisfying the GLL stopping criterion rose from 57.25% to 82.89%. Cap hits and stopping-criterion satisfaction were recorded separately and could occur at the same final iteration.

Wider GPR length-scale bounds changed mean new-subject RMSE by +0.001399; the 95th percentile of absolute changes was 0.05963 and the maximum was 0.16167. Candidate-feature ranks changed in 183/200 replicates. In Core, wide bounds with five additional restarts produced the same predictions as wide bounds alone: the original initialization achieved the best objective among all six starts. These results quantify kernel-boundary behavior, prediction changes, and ranking sensitivity separately.

II.6 Implications for the Analysis Strategy

The results support retaining different candidates for different analytical objectives, with the final strategy selected within training data.

  • Factor selection: retain MERF and RF as primary candidates because their mean recall and exact recovery are highest across nonnull designs. In correlated-decoy and contaminated scenarios, examine scenario-specific precision, any-false-positive frequency, and selection counts together. BART, GAM, and GPR provide additional recovery/false-selection combinations for comparing selection procedures.
  • New-subject prediction: retain BART as a predictive candidate and compare it with MERF using the same subject partitions. Paired results in S2, S6, and F3 support lower mean observed RMSE; report S9 with its paired interval and evaluate the known-subject task separately.
  • Smooth-structure sensitivity: retain GAMM as a sensitivity model with shared smoothing variance and subject random intercepts, assessing prediction, function curves, and estimation stability under an additive structure.
  • Presentation of relationships: the current risk-calibrated direction procedures abstain. Subsequent data analysis can report adjusted associations, bidirectional incremental predictive information, and function shapes, with direction evidence documented by its rule, coverage, and evaluated synthetic conditions.

Implementation begins by specifying a new-subject or known-subject target. Models, parameters, and selection procedures are compared using subject-grouped cross-validation inside the training data. Evaluation folds retain complete subjects, while preprocessing, tuning, and variable selection are refitted as one procedure. Final held-out subjects provide the prespecified performance evaluation, accompanied by records of model selection and variable stability.

The simulation quantifies recovery, false selection, prediction, and numerical behavior under explicit generating conditions. Task-specific candidates are retained, and evaluation within the training data determines the eventual research analysis plan.

II.7 Results and Reproducibility

The files below provide synthetic specifications, frozen rules, and public aggregate results for this part. Tables retain scenario, model, task, and effective denominators. Paired model comparisons use common data and evaluation random streams. Reproduction proceeds through calibration, rule freezing, independent validation, and paired performance evaluation, followed by aggregation of completed results.
